study_scope: historical 20 already opened official SyGuS originals, strictly POSTHOC not unseen holdout
question: Can a gold-free source-conditioned general classical structural discoverer recover useful inductive invariants not obtainable by blindly using original published Post as the invariant?

admission.identity: Source original Git blob+byte SHA pinned; original native/typed Pre,Trans,Post semantically equivalent in both Z3 and independent cvc5; original Pre SAT and not Post SAT
admission.naive_no_discovery: Candidate equals EXACT native original published Post. Independently dual prove original 3VC (original Pre=>Post; Post and original Trans=>Post next; Post=>Post), using same 8sec budgets as SPACER candidate.
admission.discovery: Call unmodified Z3 SPACER 15 sec on original source, extract its genuine inductive safety invariant AST and independently dual prove FULL actual original Pre,Trans,Post 3VC in Z3+cvc5. No supplied invariant, hidden gold, source ID rules, model, oracle label.
admission.unsafety: For authentic unsafe, generic 0..3-depth source BMC with full time-indexed state grounded and Z3+cvc5 SAT proof. UNKNOWN if no certificate; no labeling based on previous study result.
admission.no_false_new_tech: SPACER is an EXISTING strong classical solver; a matched Direct user can invoke it as-is. Never attribute its discovery to a trained learner or unique NEUMANN algorithm. This may give a bounded Q3 nonoracle capability signal, not proof of efficiency against strongest Direct or frontier capability.
admission.positive: Count candidates where dual 3VC of SPACER original truly passes while naive Post-alone candidate fails; certify stronger structure was needed for this restricted naive candidate.
admission.negative: Original positive safe post candidate may itself be inductive; retain it and do not mark structural discovery essential there. Unsafe source must NOT be promoted SAFE.
admission.global: Q3/Q4/Q5/Q6/Q7 remain OPEN; no assertion of learned unique discovery, no 10x.
